$comment: multi-agent-herdr settings (README, Configuration). These are the defaults, except integrator_name, which defaults to integrator-<repository directory name> (herdr names are unique per server); set it only to override that. Change base_branch when pull requests target an integration branch such as dev. Add an "integrators" object (for example {"max": 3, "scale_up_when_active_agents_gt": 5}) to switch to pool mode: a coordinator plus N parallel integrators (docs/multi-integrator.md).
